title: Add optimized fused FP8 x MXFP4 MegaMoE for SM90
body:
## 1. Overview

This PR adds optimized **SM90 MXFP4 MegaMoE** to `nv_dev`. Derived from [#440](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM/pull/440), with MXFP4 format and decoder foundations from [#411](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM/pull/411) (referencing Humming). Our additions include tiled register decoding, specialized small-M buckets, direct swap epilogues, MXFP4 split-M and tail optimization, and optional single-token split-K.

EP8 speedups across M=1--8192:

| EP8 shape | vs #383 FP8 | vs #440 FP8 | vs #411 MXFP4 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Flash | 1.08--1.52x | 1.08--2.04x | 1.10--1.44x |
| Pro | 1.12--1.48x | 1.32--1.89x | 1.11--1.44x |

## 2. Two key optimizations

- **Small M: tiled register decoding + RS WGMMA.** Pack each 256-row x K128 weight stage into a contiguous 16 KiB tile and decode directly into register A fragments, avoiding expanded-weight shared-memory traffic and associated synchronization. Extend #411's swapAB with N8/16/24/32/40/48 buckets, selected double buffering, and direct SwiGLU/quantization epilogues.

- **Large M and tails: MXFP4 split-M.** Use 128x256 tiles with two math warpgroups sharing decoded weights; specialize partial tiles with RS buckets, a dual N96 swap path, and empty-half WGMMA skipping. Order dynamic tails by valid rows and preserve the scaling chain for bitwise repeatability.

## 3. Performance against #411, #383, and #440: M=1--8192

- **Hardware:** H20-3e, 78 SMs/GPU, CUDA 13, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130.
- **Precision:** FP8 activations; FP8 weights for #383/#440, MXFP4 weights for #411/this PR; common source weights, routing, FP8 inputs, and fixed RNE MXFP4 quantization.
- **Timing:** CUDA Graph, seed0, 3 interleaved rounds x 50 samples.
- **Speedup:** baseline latency / this PR latency.

<details>
<summary>Validation and reproduction</summary>

- **Correctness:** single-GPU/EP8 reference and repeatability checks pass (MXFP4 tolerance 0.002; FP8 0.01); 96 per-rank outputs match the accepted pre-port implementation bitwise.
- **SASS:** six FP8 checks unchanged; 30 measured MXFP4 cubins have STACK <=16 B and no CALL.ABS.
- **Reproduction:** frozen commits, commands, maximum-rank timings, and per-round data are in `docs/sm90-fused-mxfp4-benchmarks.md` and `docs/benchmarks/sm90-fused-mxfp4-h20.csv`.

</details>

## 4. Follow-up work

- **Shared experts:** integrate and benchmark overlap with routed experts.
- **vLLM:** validate the upstream implementation and measure end-to-end latency and throughput.
- **Scheduler:** improve dispatch/compute overlap, load balancing, and tail scheduling.
- **H100/H200:** validate correctness and performance and tune hardware-specific heuristics.
